# AFD live E2E with post-activation traffic propagation window

## Requirements

- Test committed candidate `391a1544eb15e7d504fc95c95188648172cc89dd`.
- Use the standard Sweden Central shared-VNet fixture: one hub and two member
  AKS Standard clusters, two Standard_D2s_v5 nodes each.
- Enable AFD and exact caller auto-approval; disable retention and ATM.
- Run the full existing E2E suite. Require independent installed-image evidence,
  exact PLS approvals, enabled private graph, both-member HTTP responses, real
  probes, functional withdrawal and ordinary verified cleanup.
- Poll traffic for at most 45 minutes after enabled-graph verification; stop
  early on success. Do not extend total test deadlines or weaken assertions.
- Reverify effective Owner, active lifetime, quota and fresh group absence before
  Azure writes. Preserve five execution hours and 75 minutes for owned cleanup.

## Decisions

- The user explicitly approved the existing live plan and requested a restart
  after refreshing Owner. No new feature, controller or cloud topology is added.
- Preserve run 16 and its evidence. Use fresh run 17 and corrected explicit
  Windows `az aks get-credentials --file` handling.
- The 45-minute traffic window addresses possible edge propagation, not a
  confirmed explanation of run 16's HTTP 404. Keep all traffic evidence strict.
- Existing AKS CLI workflow is used; no configured AKS MCP surface is available.
- Native HTTPS remains deferred; optional ATM remains documentation-only.

## Before/After Comparison

### Run 17 measured timings

These are observed durations, not maximum timeout budgets or service guarantees.
AKS setup, other suite specs and teardown are excluded.

| Phase | Observed duration |
| --- | --- |
| Initial workload/discovery/permission preparation | Approximately 2 min 10 sec |
| PLS request discovery | 3 min 6 sec |
| Auto-approval and independent verification | 2.23 sec |
| Enabled-graph convergence | Approximately 3 min 38 sec by wall-clock timestamps |
| Fresh application traffic verified from both members | 17 min 2 sec |
| Both-member health-probe verification | Approximately 2 sec |
| Functional route withdrawal | 12 min 39 sec |
| **AFD spec entry through verified withdrawal** | **38 min 47 sec** |

The enabled-graph phase report records 3 min 30 sec elapsed, while its recorded
UTC start/end timestamps span approximately 3 min 38 sec. This discrepancy is
preserved rather than presenting either measure as exact wall-clock duration.
Traffic passed within the 45-minute window without manual activation. Final
reporting was interrupted during cleanup, so a complete test/teardown duration
and final suite-success result are unavailable.

- Before: run 16 approved both connections and verified automatic activation,
  but timed out with HTTP 404 after ten minutes; all owned groups were deleted.
- Now: run 17 is actively setting up the fresh fixture at the amended candidate.
  Fresh admission and actual owned Azure creation are verified; installed
  controller, 45-minute traffic/probe/withdrawal and cleanup outcomes are pending.
